name: Perk (TravelPerk)
summary: Perk, formerly TravelPerk, manages business travel and expense workflows. Its January 2025 Series E valued the company at $2.7 billion.
overview: Perk provides a business-travel and expense-management platform, combining booking, traveler support, payments and spend workflows.

facts.label: Latest disclosed valuation
facts.note: Kinnevik reported the post-money valuation; the company subsequently rebranded as Perk.

bull_case: A unified travel-and-expense platform can gain share as companies consolidate booking, payment and policy workflows across global teams.
bear_case: Business travel is cyclical, supplier relationships are strategically important and established expense platforms can compete for the same finance workflow.
directory_notes: Watch U.S. expansion, payments attachment and EBITDA durability.

intelligence.description: Business-travel and expense-management platform formerly known as TravelPerk.
company: Perk, formerly TravelPerk, provides a platform for booking, managing and paying for business travel. It has expanded from travel booking into a broader travel-and-expense workflow.

The company raised $200 million in a January 2025 Series E at a reported $2.7 billion post-money valuation. In 2026 it announced a $300 million private credit facility, which is financing rather than a new equity valuation.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Perk is a useful private-market benchmark for software that sits between employee experience, travel supply and the finance stack. Its ability to attach expense management and maintain growth through travel cycles will determine whether it can support a broad operating-system narrative.

changed.text: TravelPerk raised $200M at a $2.7B post-money valuation and acquired Yokoy.
The company rebranded as Perk and announced a $300M credit facility.

takeaways: The $2.7B valuation is a disclosed Series E post-money figure.
Travel and expense are adjacent workflows that can improve customer retention.
Growth remains sensitive to business-travel volumes and finance-platform competition.
